BackupHint: Replacement keeps the full originals as recovery backups. Review them before manually deleting.
DestinationHint: Blank = next to each source. Copy mode keeps folder structure. Replacement uses the source folder.
ImageHint: JPEG / PNG / WebP → WebP. Dimensions retained; RAW and animated images unsupported.
HighBitHint: H.265 only; 10-bit+ SDR converts to 10-bit 4:2:0. HDR is skipped. Keep camera masters.
QueueHint: Choose a folder and Search & compress. Files appear while processing; manual selection is optional.
ProfilesHint: Each resolution has independent settings. Dimensions and frame timing are retained. Profiles classify both portrait and landscape footage.
QualityGuide: Lower values usually increase quality. No fixed percentage loss. GPU uses CQ/QP; CPU uses CRF. Equal values do not guarantee equal quality or size. CPU veryfast is faster than medium and may produce larger files.
GuideText:
1. Choose a folder.
2. Set resolution profiles, quality and save mode once.
3. Click Search & compress. Each eligible file is discovered and encoded immediately, including subfolders.

For samples or manual selection, use optional Scan only then sample/manual queue. Keep camera masters, particularly Log and HDR. Auto performs a real encoder test and falls back to CPU. Basic verification is faster but does not decode the entire output.
Limits: No pause or restart resume. HDR skipped; audio becomes AAC. Some camera metadata is omitted. GPU speed depends on hardware, driver and codec. No guaranteed time or file size.
ReplaceWarning: The original files will be moved to recovery backups after validation. Backups still consume space. Keep them until you have checked the output in your editor. Continue?
SampleEstimate: One-hour estimate: ≈ {0} min · estimated full output: {1}. From one sample, including verification; results vary.
RecoveryFound: Recovery transaction found. Inspect .framepress-transaction-*.json and restore the original backup before retrying.
AccelerationHint: Auto benchmarks GPU and CPU encoders on a short source sample and picks the fastest working encoder. Initial testing adds time; results cache per resolution/settings for this session. Quality scales differ between encoders.
VerificationHint: Copies: basic validation by default, original retained. Replacement: full decode always required, with recovery backup.
GpuUnknown: GPU name unavailable; encoder tests still work
